Match exact reference sprite craft: small crisp pixel clusters, dark quiet interiors, thin chipped highlights, controlled fine material texture, no chunky cartoon outlines. A 4 by 4 equal grid on 1536x1536 transparent canvas, one complete independent hazard strip per cell, wide low 3:1 silhouette, flat grounded base and immediately readable upward sharp tips. Generous truly transparent gaps, no labels or text, no ground plane, no halos. Identical pixel detail scale across all16. Top-left to bottom-right ROW MAJOR:
